messages.author: 10e957ce9e421e1f
messages.subject: Failed to connect to database: Error: Access denied for user
parts:
I'm trying to launch my first app - this app works fine locally but greys out on shinyapps.io. It appears the app doesn't recognize my permissions to the MYSQL database (see below). Any thoughts on how to grant permissions or edit my dbConnect script to accommodate? Thanks!

My dbConnect: 

  conn <- dbConnect(MySQL(), user='ca_elo_games', password='xxxxx',
                    host='mysql.crowd-scout.net', db='nhl_all')
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(conn))

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Failed to connect to database: Error: Access denied for user
parts:
Cole,

MySQL users are restricted to a particular host. You'll likely need to update your user record in MySQL to allow connections from any host. This is typically done by creating a user with a wildcard host and granting them privileges. 

CREATE USER 'my-user'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'my-password';
GRANT ALL ON mydatabase.* TO 'my-user'@'%';

-Andy

                    host='mysql.crowd-scout.net', db='nhl_all')
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(conn))

messages.subject: Re: Failed to connect to database: Error: Access denied for user
parts: Great - this works, I just had to change my 'allowable hosts' in dreamhost to '%'. What is the specific host name of shinyapps.io to prevent any other third parties from connecting to my database?

On Thu, Oct 15, 2015 at 11:50 AM Andy Kipp <an...@rstudio.com> wrote:
It's been ages since I've used phpmyadmin, but I think there is a way to edit user information with that tool... I would try searching on how to add user with phpmyadmin.

On Thu, Oct 15, 2015 at 2:44 PM, Cole Anderson <cole92a...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thanks - this make sense. I haven't set up a shell interface yet, do you know if I can do this on phpmyadmin or dreamhost (my server).

On Thu, Oct 15, 2015 at 11:14 AM Andy Kipp <an...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Cole,

MySQL users are restricted to a particular host. You'll likely need to update your user record in MySQL to allow connections from any host. This is typically done by creating a user with a wildcard host and granting them privileges. 

CREATE USER 'my-user'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'my-password';
GRANT ALL ON mydatabase.* TO 'my-user'@'%';

-Andy

On Thu, Oct 15, 2015 at 2:02 PM, Cole Anderson <cole92a...@gmail.com> wrote:
I'm trying to launch my first app - this app works fine locally but greys out on shinyapps.io. It appears the app doesn't recognize my permissions to the MYSQL database (see below). Any thoughts on how to grant permissions or edit my dbConnect script to accommodate? Thanks!

My dbConnect: 

  conn <- dbConnect(MySQL(), user='ca_elo_games', password='xxxxx',
                    host='mysql.crowd-scout.net', db='nhl_all')
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(conn))
